prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Discover a personalized virtual companion that lives right on your desktop display."]
1: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop", "Next: View Controls", "Quick Desktop Controls", "Right-click your pet anytime on your desktop to access quick actions, hide to system tray, or start chat.", "Get Started"]
2: ["Meet Your Potential Companions", "Swipe through different companion breeds and hear their unique sounds.", "Select Breed"]
3: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "We are generating your pet's custom graphics, sound effects, and desktop behaviors.", "Rendering 3D pet model", "Configuring desktop AI"]
4: ["Sync Your Pet to Your Account", "Signing in ensures your pet's memories, level, and custom appearance are safely backed up in the cloud.", "Sign In to Save Pet"]
5: ["Don't worry! You can easily change your companion type later in App Settings."]
6: ["Tip: Feed your pet daily to build affection!"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize their desktop adoption.", "Official Registered Companion", "Enter pet name"]
8: ["Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Check your taskbar or system tray if minimized.", "Pet icon added to your primary display."]
9: ["Quick Sign In", "Connect your account to save your companion's progress.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
